newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuba praises China for Hong Kong transfer.
newsitem.headline: Cuba praises China for Hong Kong transfer.

text.p: Cuba on Tuesday heaped praise on China, a fellow communist state, for regaining Hong Kong from Britain and said the transfer had been a "triumph for Chinese wisdom and socialism".

Foreign Minister Roberto Robaina was quoted by the Cuban news agency Prensa Latina as saying that Monday's handover had shown the world that "the shortest roads to an objective may be patience and intelligence."

China had startled the world with its "creativity, maturity, authenticity and responsibility," Robaina said, adding he hoped for the advance of the ideas of "equity, justice and solidarity" in Hong Kong.

He also praised late Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping's concept of "one country, two systems", which underpinned the handover agreement, as interesting for socialism and "for the ideas of peaceful co-existence in a pluralist world".

Cuba's relations with China have warmed over the last decade after being strained in the past by Havana's close ties with the former Soviet Union. But Havana's economic liberalisation in the last five years has so far stopped far short of China's.
